provider_plan.route: Codex ChatGPT subscription only; explicit model_provider=openai; no API-key or OpenRouter fallback
provider_plan.attempt_preflight: Before every attempt, use the existing selected account home (never copy or symlink auth to a temporary CODEX_HOME), verify its auth-file digest and distinct ChatGPT account identity, then app-server account/rateLimits/read and model/list under that CODEX_HOME. Stop unless ordinaryUsageAllowed=true, limitId=codex, primary usedPercent < 80, and gpt-6-luna is present.
provider_plan.on_missing_usage: retain failed/unscored attempt and stop before any further admission
provider_plan.on_auth_or_quota_failure: stop; no alternate account for the attempt and no API-key/OpenRouter fallback
provider_plan.on_limit_or_model_change: retain failed/unscored attempt and stop campaign
provider_plan.response_artifacts: Retain each selected answer and sanitized whole-turn usage/tool/source receipts in an owner-only private output directory; retain per-response usage only if a native event exposes it, otherwise mark per-response usage unknown. Do not retain raw JSONL, source bodies, or credentials. Record exact argv, CWD, selected config hashes, CLI hash/version, and account-home alias.
provider_plan.workspace: Fixed isolated bwrap workspace /work; no repo/worktree, FROZEN.json, fixture sources, operational memory, or private output mounted in model tool space. Copy pinned repository AGENTS.md only. Preserve the selected existing CODEX_HOME for Codex runtime auth/config/instructions; do not claim it is hidden from shell tools. Disable code_mode_only, code_mode, and shell_tool with the frozen CLI flags. Verify the model tool inventory per arm. Any unexpected shell/code/file tool or unproved separation of auth/private output fails admission.
provider_plan.resolved_model_observation: Record provider model identity only when an actual native event exposes it; otherwise null/unknown. Never infer resolved identity from the requested alias or model catalog.
provider_plan.cwd_policy: Fixed isolated CWD /work. Copy the exact repository AGENTS.md to /work/AGENTS.md (SHA-256 bbe777861b084ceea60ce01901edf5fafd55c710e43facdb2fb52f303dd98c49); keep the selected existing CODEX_HOME available to Codex runtime for auth/config/user instructions without copying/symlinking auth. Do not mount repository, panel manifest, fixture/source files, operational memory, or private output in model tool workspace. Freeze argv, CWD, instruction/config hashes identically across arms; include all instruction/tool overhead in token ceilings.
provider_plan.stop_threshold: Stop before an attempt when assigned account primary usedPercent is >=80; also stop on ordinaryUsageAllowed=false, unavailable/malformed status, model/catalog mismatch, auth/account mismatch, or provider auth/quota error. The 80% value is an operational tripwire, not an absolute allowance or expected cost.
provider_plan.workspace_policy: Use fixed bwrap CWD /work with pinned AGENTS.md. Keep repository, FROZEN.json, fixture/source files, operational memory, and private answer/receipt output outside model tool space. Preserve selected existing CODEX_HOME for Codex runtime without copying/symlinking auth; do not assume it is hidden from shell tools. Disable code_mode_only, code_mode, and shell_tool using the frozen flags. The runner must prove bwrap hides repo/fixture/output and native tool offers match the per-arm allowlist; unexpected tools fail closed. If auth/private output separation or model tool inventory cannot be demonstrated, stop before provider admission.
provider_plan.cwd_policy_hash_status: The private runner must recheck each home AGENTS/config/auth digest, capture exact argv/CWD/workspace hashes, and bind them before admission; any drift requires plan review.
provider_plan.usage_accounting: Use terminal turn.completed whole-turn usage as authoritative panel telemetry, deduplicated per turn. input_tokens includes cached input; do not add cached_input_tokens a second time. Per-response usage is unknown unless a native event explicitly exposes it; do not infer or allocate whole-turn usage among responses.
provider_plan.tool_offer_contract: The provider-free local fixture is evidence only about its loopback request and fake runtime: the request declares generic functions.exec, and the attempted call is runtime denied with code_mode_host=false. This fail-closed result does not prove which tools a subscribed provider offers. Registry and request-shape proxies are not subscribed offered-tool evidence. Stop on any unexpected actual tool call: direct arms stop on every tool call; retrieval arms stop on every call other than Cairn search/pull.
provider_plan.tool_availability_preflight: The provider-free blank-root bwrap fake-home test mounts only a synthetic CODEX_HOME with a fake sentinel, /work, the Codex package, and system runtime. Exact flags: `--disable code_mode_only --disable code_mode --disable code_mode_host --disable shell_tool`. Invocation also used `codex exec --ephemeral --json --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --skip-git-repo-check --cd /work --sandbox read-only --model gpt-6-luna`, approval_policy=never, medium effort, and a custom loopback fixture provider. The loopback Responses stub advertised functions.exec with a fake call attempting to read the synthetic auth sentinel. Codex emitted a completed error item, "Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled", then a normal agent message and completed turn after the stub’s second response. Two loopback requests; sentinel absent from tool output, second request, and stdout; zero external calls. Separately, `codex --disable code_mode_only --disable code_mode --disable code_mode_host --disable shell_tool features list` reported all four effective values false. A direct-arm request-shape probe made one loopback request with no Cairn declarations; the generic functions/exec list was unchanged. The request-shape digest was 1b536a8b13d728340d89487f4a3c35045ba6fa848b8288e6a15e986ee9b5ab7a; it is not retained source proof. These observations cover only the local fake request/runtime and do not prove the subscribed provider tool inventory. Stop on any unexpected actual tool call: direct arms stop on every tool call; retrieval arms stop on every call other than Cairn search/pull. Registry or request-shape proxies cannot establish subscribed offered tools. If bwrap isolation, effective feature state, account binding, or actual tool-call policy cannot be proved, do not admit provider work.
provider_plan.effective_feature_check: Run `codex --disable code_mode_only --disable code_mode --disable code_mode_host --disable shell_tool features list` under the exact invocation environment and require all four effective values false. The exact-invocation blank-root bwrap fake-auth request/call test must separately observe the runtime denial "Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled" for a scripted functions.exec call. Record both results. Missing/malformed effective values or a different/missing runtime denial stops admission; flags alone do not prove effective state.
